values.name: text
values.prose: The tbd-fg and tbd-bg keywords indicate the role of the base color in calculating the contrast: as text against a list of candidate background colors (textInfo about the 'text' reference.#valdef-contrast-color-textPossible linking syntaxes:''contrast-color()/text'') or as a background against a list of candidate text colors. (The effective contrast of a pair of colors depends on their usage.)
